Build a Windows desktop application in Java 17+ (Maven project) that tracks air-raid
alert status for Ukraine using the free, key-less JSON endpoint:

  GET https://jaam.net.ua/alerts_statuses_v3.json
  → returns { "states": { "<regionFriendlyName>": true|false, ... } }  (true = alert active)

  GET https://ubilling.net.ua/aerialalerts/?map=rednight
  → returns a PNG map of current alert state across regions.

(If either URL is unreachable, fall back to making these base URLs configurable in a
single constants class so I can swap endpoints without touching logic.)

=====================================
NON-NEGOTIABLE CONSTRAINTS
=====================================
- Keep the codebase small and readable: aim for <= 8 classes, no frameworks
  (no Spring, no JavaFX, no Swing UI beyond SystemTray + one simple JFrame).
- Use ONLY JDK built-ins: java.net.http.HttpClient, java.util.prefs OR plain file I/O,
  javax.imageio.ImageIO, java.awt.SystemTray/TrayIcon/PopupMenu, javax.sound.sampled.Clip.
- The app must run headless in the background: no main window on startup, no taskbar
  button (set the tray-only JFrame's type/utility flag or keep it minimized & undecorated),
  single-instance guard (throw/exiting if another instance holds a lock file).
- All network calls off the EDT, on a single ScheduledExecutorService.

=====================================
TRAY MENU (exactly these items, this order)
=====================================
1. Region ▸           — submenu of all region names
2. Auto-start   ☐     — toggle checkbox item
3. Suspend      ☐     — toggle: pauses polling & sound while checked
4. Show map           — opens/focuses the map window
5. Exit               — clean shutdown (stop scheduler, close clips, remove tray icon)

Menu labels update live (checkmarks reflect current config/state).

=====================================
BEHAVIOR SPEC
=====================================
A) FIRST LAUNCH / REGION PICKER
   - On first run, fetch the region list from the API once to get human-readable
	 names.
   - No config file exists yet → show ONE modal dialog (top-most) listing regions,
     user picks one, write it to %APPDATA%/jOpenAlert/config.properties
     (keys: regionFriendlyName, autoStart, suspended, lastState). Then hide all windows.
   - Subsequent launches read that file silently; never show a window unless asked.

B) POLLING LOOP
   - Every 20 seconds (fixed-rate schedule) GET alerts_statuses_v3.json, parse the chosen region's
     boolean. Skip the tick entirely while "Suspend" is checked.
   - Compare against the previous value held in memory; also persist lastState to config
     so a restart doesn't replay sounds spuriously.
   - Transitions:
       false → true  : play src/main/res/assets/begin.wav
       true  → false : play src/main/res/assets/end.wav
       (no sound on startup regardless of initial value)
   - Load both WAVs once at startup via AudioSystem.getClip(); play on a dedicated
     thread so playback never blocks the poller or the EDT. Handle missing files by
     logging a warning once, not crashing. Ignore non-PCM formats gracefully.
   - Network errors: log, keep last known state, retry next tick. Back off to 60s after
     3 consecutive failures, reset to 20s on success. Never let an exception kill the loop.

C) AUTO-START TOGGLE
   - Copy a preconfigured shortcut entry from src/main/res/assets/jOpenAlert.lnk to $APPDATA/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup
   - Toggle writes/removes that file AND updates the config flag. Write a tiny helper
     class encapsulating this so it's easy to swap implementations.

D) MAP WINDOW ("Show map")
   - One reusable JFrame, always-on-top (setAlwaysOnTop(true)), resizable, title
     "Ukraine Air Alerts", centered on first open.
   - Shows the PNG from the map endpoint scaled to fit the pane (preserve aspect ratio).
   - Refresh the image every 20s while the window is OPEN; stop refreshing when disposed
     (dispose on close, don't quit the app). Debounce double-clicks on the menu item by
     reusing/showing the existing frame instead of opening duplicates.
   - Add a manual "Refresh" button and a label showing last-updated time.

=====================================
PROJECT LAYOUT
=====================================
src/main/java/com/github/kekneus373/jopenalert/
  Main.java            // bootstrap, single-instance, tray install, shutdown hook
  Config.java          // load/save %APPDATA% properties, defaults
  AlertApi.java        // HttpClient wrapper: fetchStates(), fetchMapPng(), fetchRegions()
  Poller.java          // ScheduledExecutorService, diff detection, backoff
  SoundPlayer.java     // loads begin.wav/end.wav, async play
  TrayManager.java     // builds PopupMenu, wires actions
  MapWindow.java       // resizable always-on-top PNG viewer
  AutoStart.java       // launcher toggle
src/main/res/assets/{begin.wav,end.wav}
pom.xml                // shade plugin → single runnable fat JAR, Main-Class set

=====================================
DELIVER IN THIS ORDER
=====================================
1. pom.xml (Java 17, maven-shade-plugin, no third-party deps).
2. Each class above, complete and compiling — no "// TODO implement".
3. A short README.md: how to build (mvn package), where assets go, how auto-start works,
   how to change the API base URL, and a note that SystemTray requires a desktop session.

Rules while writing code: prefer try-with-resources, use var where clear, no wildcard
imports, handle InterruptedException correctly (restore interrupt flag), and make every
user-visible string a constant so I can localize later. Flag any assumption you had to
make about the API shape at the top of your reply as a bullet list before the code.
